title: Oceanic Moroccan Dried Shrimp Seffa
description: A light and flavorful Moroccan dish featuring dried shrimp, perfect for a monsoon day, this seffa is a fun and easy meal to prepare, it is also buddhist-temple-friendly
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the vermicelli pasta according to package instructions
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until translucent
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the skillet and cook for 1 minute
Add the soaked and drained dried shrimp to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes
Stir in the cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute
Drain the cooked vermicelli pasta and add it to the skillet, stirring to combine with the shrimp and spice mixture
Reduce heat to low and simmer the seffa for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally
Serve the seffa hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro
